findings.evidence: Tracer story TASK-3.1 (ordinal 11000) depends only on TASK-1.5 and TASK-6.1, yet its ACs need work ordered after it: AC4 (hole cards face up) needs card rendering TASK-3.5 (ordinal 20000, last M1 story); AC1/AC3 (stacks, bottom-centre seat) need seat display TASK-3.3 (14000, depends on 3.1); AC5/AC7 (user's turn, acting) need the action bar TASK-3.2 (12000, depends on 3.1). 3.2 and 3.3 depend on 3.1, so the order cannot be satisfied; 3.3 AC3 (cards face up) also lacks a dependency on 3.5.
findings.fix: Make 3.1 a thin tracer whose ACs need no later UI (turn handling and bot play proven at engine/session level), move the face-up, stack and seat ACs to TASK-3.3/3.5, add 3.3->3.5 and 3.2->3.5 dependencies, and give TASK-3.5 an ordinal before TASK-3.3.

findings.evidence: Every story DoD requires 'CI workflow is green on the story's branch' [REQ-064.2] and E01 outcome 1 says CI runs 'from the first story', but the CI story TASK-1.7 depends only on TASK-1.1 and sits at ordinal 18000, after the engine, advice, bot and table stories (ordinals 2000-17000). Those stories' DoD cannot be met when built in order.
findings.fix: Move TASK-1.7 right after TASK-1.1 (ordinal about 1500); TASK-1.8 can keep its later position since it adds the playtest step.

findings.evidence: DoD#7 requires axe with zero serious/critical violations for every story that adds a screen, starting with M1 stories TASK-2.1, 3.x, 9.1. TASK-1.1#AC7 provisions Playwright (Chromium and WebKit) but no axe tooling; axe first appears in TASK-13.11 (M3).
findings.fix: Add axe integration (helper plus a smoke check) to TASK-1.1 or to a small M1 story, and make the screen stories depend on it.

findings.location: M2 description and story-map 'M2 MVP: every Must requirement'; TASK-5.6 (REQ-002.6), TASK-10.12 (REQ-044.1), TASK-11.9 (REQ-048.5); requirements REQ-002, REQ-044, REQ-048 (Must) vs REQ-008 (Should)
findings.evidence: Clauses REQ-002.6, REQ-044.1 (sit-and-go finishing position) and REQ-048.5 belong to Must requirements but depend on the Should sit-and-go feature, so they are scheduled in M3. M2 is therefore not 'every Must requirement' as claimed. The requirement-level priority does not say whether these sub-clauses are Must.
findings.fix: User decides: downgrade these clauses to Should (and keep them in M3) or require SNG in M2. Then the milestone text can be made true.

findings.location: TASK-5.6, TASK-10.9, TASK-10.12, TASK-11.9 (High, m-2); TASK-3.6 (Medium, m-1)
findings.evidence: Four M3 stories carry High priority while the other 59 M3 stories are Medium or Low; TASK-10.9 mainly covers a Could requirement (REQ-003) and TASK-5.6 a SNG-only Should feature. Priority is inherited from the parent Must requirement rather than the story's value. Conversely M2 TASK-3.6 (off-main-thread, REQ-055.6) is Medium.
findings.fix: Set the priority from the story's milestone and clause priorities (Medium/Low for these M3 stories), or record why they are High.

findings.evidence: G-5 is '200+ hands/hour at fast speed', but no AC measures hands per hour. REQ-011 only bounds the bot gap at Rapid (300 ms) and the fixed 1.5 s auto-deal dominates. In M1 and M2 no pace setting exists, since REQ-011 is in M3, so bot pace is undefined before then. 4.9 only displays pace. G-5 is not shown to hold for a user playing at a normal speed.
findings.fix: User to confirm how G-5 is verified, for example a seeded timed run with a scripted user at Rapid achieving at least 200 hands/hour. Then add an AC. Also decide whether a default fast pace is needed in M2.

findings.location: Vision G-3 (positive BB/100 vs the standard mixed line-up after 5,000 hands); TASK-6.12, 6.10, 11.2
findings.evidence: No story or global check shows that sound play beats the mixed line-up. TASK-6.12 only proves TAG beats single-style tables, and TASK-11.2 only charts BB/100. The goal is a user outcome that depends on advice and bot calibration; the backlog does not say how it is validated.
findings.fix: User to decide whether G-3 needs a headless check (for example an advice-following bot beating the Mixed preset over 100k hands) or is observational only.

findings.location: vision.md section 0 and 4 ('Good / Minor / Major') vs requirements and TASK-7.4, 9.1 ('Correct, Minor error, Major error', Q-42)
findings.evidence: The approved vision names the grades Good/Minor/Major while requirements and every story use Correct/Minor error/Major error. The requirements are fixed by Q-42, so the vision is stale.
findings.fix: Update the vision wording or note the Q-42 override.

findings.evidence: M1 stories carry 'golden-spot suite passes 100%' in DoD but the suite is created only in TASK-7.11 (M2), so for M1 it is vacuous. Harmless but noisy.
findings.fix: Note in the DoD that it applies once TASK-7.11 exists, or create an empty suite harness in TASK-1.1.

summary: Mechanical layer is clean (344/344 clauses covered, 0 errors). M1 forms a plausible end-to-end skeleton: toolchain, engine, advice, TAG bots, table, Home to default table, basic review. Two ordering defects break its buildability (tracer 3.1 needs UI stories ordered after it; CI story ordered after the stories whose DoD needs it). The C5-AND warnings (E05, E10-S11, E11) are false positives or minor, and the C3-NOM1 warnings are intended. The rest are milestone/priority consistency and goal-measurement gaps that need user decisions (G-3, G-5, Must clauses in M3).
